paper.abstract_en: We argue that the purely topological gluing of AdS$_3$ spacetimes, which are otherwise independent due to Dirichlet boundary conditions, can still produce non-trivial spaces after a quotient. In this direction, we extend the study of a recently discovered non-orientable AdS$_3$, which is a $\mathbb Z_2$ quotient of two AdS$_3$ spaces glued along their conformal boundaries. We find that this space is compact and boundaryless and that the quotient sends the gluing surface to a torus comprised of a null lattice with halved periods. However, the bulk wraps around both its sides, which means that as an embedded space this gluing surface forms a one-sided torus. We discover that it supports a permutation-twisted sector of two CFT$_2$s with shared Dirichlet boundary conditions and conjecture that conformal maps can be extended across this gluing surface. Using this extension, we show that the vacuum of pairs of Rindler wedges, which share a boundary in this non-orientable AdS$_3\times$S$^2$ space, are conformal to static patch vacua, which are supported on two dS$_4\times \mathbb R$ glued together at their conformal boundaries.
